ACTION: COMMIX
TARGET: http://192.168.56.10/mutillidae/index.php?page=dns-lookup.php
PARAMETERS: --url="http://192.168.56.10/mutillidae/index.php?page=dns-lookup.php" --data="target_host=127.0.0.1&dns-lookup-php-submit-button=Lookup+DNS" --batch
REASON: SQLMAP keeps testing the GET parameter 'page' instead of the POST form fields, which is causing repeated failures. The Mutillidae application has a DNS Lookup page that is documented as vulnerable to Command Injection (visible in the menu from the CURL output). COMMIX is specifically designed for command injection testing and will properly test the POST parameter 'target_host' in the DNS lookup form. Command injection can lead to direct shell access, which is more valuable than SQL injection for system compromise. The DNS lookup functionality typically executes system commands like 'nslookup' or 'dig', making it a prime target for OS command injection.
